Whether you’re marking products on the production line or labeling packages in the warehouse, a reliable printing solution can make all the difference. That’s where the BENTSAI Handheld Inkjet Printer steps in — a smart, portable device designed to meet the growing demands of modern labeling. What is the BENTSAI Printer? The BENTSAI printer is a handheld thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer that delivers high-resolution, quick-dry printing on a wide range of surfaces. It’s compact, lightweight, and wireless — giving users complete freedom to print whenever and wherever needed without the constraints of large, stationary machines. Key Features High-Quality Printing: Up to 600 DPI resolution for sharp, professional-looking prints. Versatile Surface Compatibility: Works perfectly on cardboard, metal, plastic, wood, glass, textiles, pipes, and even stone. User-Friendly Interface: A built-in 4.3″ or 5″ LCD touchscreen for easy operation and previewing before printing. Long Battery Life: Rechargeable battery providing up to 16 hours of continuous operation. Multiple Print Options: Supports barcodes, QR codes, logos, batch numbers, expiration dates, and more. Offline or USB Printing: Upload your data via USB drive or create it directly on the device without any software. Why Choose BENTSAI?
